# SA2 Session Plan fixtures

Retrieved 2026-10-29 (Asia/Seoul) from the 3GPP archive (`tsg_sa/WG2_Arch/`):

- `S2-2608833_SA2-176-Session Plan - r20.docx`: the last plan of SA2#176 (Prague, 2026-08-24..28),
  from `TSGS2_176_Prague_2026-08/INBOX/DRAFTS/_Session_Plan_Updates/`. Tracked insertions and a
  deletion, the opening merged over three streams, the Friday plenary with its written times,
  identical text in both cells of a quarter, Q0 with two different cells.
- `S2-2509839_SA2-172-Session Plan - r12.docx`: SA2#172 (Dallas), from the ZIP of that name in the
  meeting's `Agenda/` folder. Lunch-row drafting with times and rooms written in the text
  (`Drafting: (1300) FS_ARCH_enIMS (main room)`), `Revisions` on Thursday and Friday.
- `S2-2601721_SA2-174-Session Plan -r9.docx`: SA2#174 (Malta), from the ZIP of that name in the
  meeting's `Agenda/` folder. The vice-chair election in the lunch row, two topics run together
  (`TEI20_DAMP [1]TEI20_UDCE-ARC [2]`), three conveners.
- `agenda_176.csv`: `agenda.csv` from `TSGS2_176_Prague_2026-08/Agenda/` (regenerated in place; a snapshot).
- `S2-261nnnn_SA2-178-Session Plan.docx`: the first plan of SA2#178 (Calgary, 2026-11-16..20), from the ZIP
  of that name in `TSGS2_178_Calgary_2026-11/INBOX/DRAFTS/_Session_Plan_Updates/` (retrieved 2026-11-02).
  Q2's range written `1100 - 12`, seat counts in parentheses (`Palomino E-H (300)`), and cells that
  move a stream to another room (`In breakout 1`, `In main room`).
- `S2-2509839_SA2-172-Session Plan - r2.docx`: SA2#172, from the ZIP of that name in the meeting's
  `Agenda/OLDER/` folder. Wednesday's two cells are three grid columns (1843, 1 and 1701 twips) because
  Word cut the rows at slightly different places, and a tracked table change keeps an older grid.
- `agenda_178.csv`: `agenda.csv` from `TSGS2_178_Calgary_2026-11/Agenda/` (retrieved 2026-11-02; a snapshot).

SA2#177's plans are not used: their `word/people.xml` carries an author's e-mail address.
These plans were checked for e-mail addresses, meeting links, IDs and passcodes; they have none.

Tests read these files without network access.
